topic.title: Translating XLIFF Using Oxygen AI Translator

body.p: After generating the XLIFF file, you can translate it directly in using the AI Translator add-on. To access the action to translate XLIFF with the AI Translator, right-click on a DITA map in the Project View or DITA Maps Manager and select Translate (Fluenta) Translate XLIFF using Oxygen AI Translator . This action is visible only if there is a Fluenta project associated with the selected DITA map. This add-on automates the translation process with AI models and provides advanced translation management features. For more information, see AI Translator Add-on.
